title: Field-aware invert of a prior SetMarkers command
aggregateCanonical: sha256 of sorted "digest  path\n" lines of sourceSha256
bounds: Field-aware invert of a prior non-tip SetMarkers command restores only that command's marker write set when those fields still match the after-image. Earlier captions and an unrelated leave-gap MoveClip of a non-host remnant stay.

A later edit to those markers, a followed clipLocal marker that has already moved with its host, or invert of the tip / undo / redo / invertCommand itself, is whole-group UNDO_CONFLICT and does not roll the database back. Linear undo/redo stay tip snapshot restores. Official InversePatch kind stays restoreSnapshot.

A real UI path imports AV, extracts persistent audio, splits, adds a clipLocal cue, adds an absolute marker, moves the right remnant, inverts the SetMarkers command, then undoes, redoes, archives a fork, and exports a VTT sidecar. Preview and MP4 still refuse CAPTION_RENDER_POLICY_NOT_IMPLEMENTED.

Already-delivered SetTrackState locked, overwrite, LiftClips/Cut, MoveClip, Delete/Trim, insert-move leave-gap, includeLinks=false, caption default/follow/interval/source-window, marker absolute default / clipLocal follow / ripple interval, 1000 seeded random undo, and the opened section-3 geometry matrix stay unchanged. Source-interval crop stays ANCHOR_OUT_OF_RANGE. Lifting a clipLocal-marker host stays REF_NOT_FOUND. Video/caption mute/solo stay FEATURE_NOT_IMPLEMENTED; syncLock is not toggled. Auto-close-on-move, new-track, cross-project bake, OS clipboard, marker sidecar formats, a complete invert matrix, I-006, MP4 burn-in, and the table's 0.02s off-grid offset are not in this slice.
